subject: Mutual Action: Integration milestones + evaluation plan — NorthStar
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@northstar.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: integration@northstar.com, Samir Rao <samir@northstar.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan and evaluation kickoff for NorthStar integration

Hi Soojin / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the NorthStar payments team is ready to move to the MAP and begin the evaluation run. I attached our draft MAP (NS_MAP_v1.xlsx) and an initial SOW (SOW_Draft.pdf). High level ask: we want an integration that covers SDK embedding in our backend, API-based streaming for webhook events, OAuth-based auth for end-user connections, and the tool-calling surface for our reconciliation microservice.

Key timeline target: we want a validation demo and acceptance tests by the week of Dec 13th so we can cut a PO for Dedicated capacity before year-end.

Questions as we kick this off:
- Can you confirm owners for SDK, API streaming, auth, and tool-calling flows?
- Do you have a recommended evaluation prompt set / criteria we should run?
- Any anticipated blockers for December acceptance?

I've cc'd our integration lead (integration@northstar.com) and Samir who will run the test plan.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Director, Integrations — NorthStar Payments

Attachments: NS_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@northstar.com>, integration@northstar.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and evaluation kickoff for NorthStar integration

Alex — thanks for the clear MAP & SOW. We reviewed the files this morning and sketched a proposed owner/ETA split below. Attaching our response workbook (redwood_map_response.xlsx) with proposed milestones.

Owners & initial scope (please confirm):
- SDK/API integration (server-side SDK + token lifecycle): Karthik Iyer — primary owner. Target: dev sandbox working + CI tests by 2026-12-06.
- OAuth & tenant auth flow (end-user connect): Monica Patel — primary owner. Target: config + test harness by 2026-12-09.
- Streaming & event fanout (API streaming/webhook reliability): Rachel Kim — primary owner. Target: streaming e2e test by 2026-12-13 (demo target week).
- Tool-calling surface (reconciliation microservice): cross-team (Karthik + Product); prototype calls in sandbox by 2026-12-08.

Weekly checkpoints: we propose a 30 minute sync every Friday starting 2026-11-26, status + blockers + action items. Can we lock Fridays 11:00 PT for the next four weeks?

Immediate asks for NorthStar before our first weekly:
- Share the list of acceptance prompts (or let us reformat into our eval harness); link to Drive would be ideal.
- Confirm if OAuth client creation is on your side or if you want Redwood to create a client in your test tenant.

I'll kick off the internal owners and add standing calendar invites if you confirm Friday 11:00 PT.

— Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_map_response.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Alex Park <alex.park@northstar.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and evaluation kickoff for NorthStar integration

Quick update on SDK/API tasks (short note ahead of Friday):

Progress:
- Created initial SDK adapter repo and opened PR for token refresh flow: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ns-integ/pull/42
- Basic end-to-end generate + streaming harness wired to sandbox keys; local smoke tests pass for short sequences.

Blockers / risks:
- OAuth client config: Samir, we need the test-client ID & redirect URIs for your sandbox tenant. Without that we have to mock the exchange which will push demo validation later.
- Large-sequence streaming perf: we see increased tail latency for >4k token windows in the sandbox. I have a perf experiment but need a small dataset from you to reproduce reliably.

Action items assigned:
- Karthik: finalize PR for token lifecycle & add CI job (ETA 2026-12-02). Attachment: oauth-config-sample.txt (sample config schema).
- Monica: will validate tenant-scoped scopes with Samir (ETA 2026-11-30).
- Rachel: push streaming test harness to staging (ETA 2026-12-05).

I can demo the PR changes in the Friday sync; please let me know if you want the walkthrough earlier.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: oauth-config-sample.txt (txt)

From: Alex Park <alex.park@northstar.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: integration@northstar.com, Samir Rao <samir@northstar.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and evaluation kickoff for NorthStar integration

Thanks team — Friday 11:00 PT works for us as a recurring checkpoint. Samir, please share the sandbox client details (Samir: sra o@northstar.com) and the small sample dataset for streaming perf (we'll redact PII).

We will also attach our acceptance prompt set to the Drive link by Monday; aim is to lock the evaluation criteria so Redwood can run nightly evals ahead of the demo.

One ask on tool-calling: our reconciliation microservice accepts a /sync call and expects a JSON payload with id, amount, and confidence. Can someone from Redwood propose a minimal contract (schema + retry semantics) by the Friday sync?

Appreciate the clarity and early milestones — see you Friday.

— Alex
Director, Integrations — NorthStar Payments

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@northstar.com>, integration@northstar.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and evaluation kickoff for NorthStar integration — weekly checkpoint notes

Notes from today's 11:00 PT weekly checkpoint (short):

Attendees: Alex (NorthStar), Samir (NorthStar), Soojin, Karthik, Monica, Rachel

Meeting summary:
- Confirmed Fridays 11:00 PT as standing weekly for MAP checkpoints (next 4 weeks).
- SDK/API: Karthik has PR in flight (GH PR #42). CI job to run token lifecycle tests by 2026-12-02.
- Auth: Monica needs sandbox client ID from Samir; Samir to share before EOD Monday 11/30.
- Streaming: Rachel will push staging harness and run perf test with NorthStar sample dataset; target to complete by 2026-12-05.
- Tool-calling: Redwood to propose minimal reconciliation contract (schema + idempotency/retry guidance) — Karthik to draft by 2026-12-01.

Action items (owners & due):
1) Samir (NorthStar): share sandbox client ID & redirect URI — due 2026-11-30.
2) NorthStar: upload evaluation prompt set to shared Drive — due 2026-11-30.
3) Karthik (Redwood): finalize token lifecycle PR & draft reconciliation contract (schema + retry semantics) — due 2026-12-01. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ns-integ/pull/42
4) Monica (Redwood): confirm scopes & run initial auth tests when client ID available — due 2026-12-03.
5) Rachel (Redwood): run streaming perf with provided dataset; report tail latency numbers in next sync — due 2026-12-05.

Blockers escalated: streaming tail latency for >4k token windows (Karthik) and missing sandbox OAuth client (Samir).

Next sync: Fri 2026-12-03 11:00 PT — agenda: demo PR changes, review nightly eval outputs, confirm auth handshake.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: weekly_checkpoint_notes_20261128.docx (docx)
